# kcore_ingress_gateway (Resource)

Ingress gateway (kind: IngressGateway): Caddy with the Coraza WAF on one or two nodes, with ACME certificates and an optional keepalived VIP. Apply pushes the node configuration, so expect a NixOS rebuild. Destroy fails while routes still use the gateway; Terraform orders that for you when the routes reference kcore_ingress_gateway.<name>.name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kcore_waf_policy" "crs" {
  name = "crs-default"
  spec = jsonencode({
    engine = "detect" # logs only; switch to block after reading the WAF events
    crs = {
      paranoiaLevel           = 1
      inboundAnomalyThreshold = 5
    }
    requestBodyLimitBytes = 1048576
  })
}

resource "kcore_ingress_gateway" "edge" {
  name = "edge"
  spec = jsonencode({
    nodes = ["node-105"]
    listeners = [{
      address = "203.0.113.10"
      ports   = [80, 443]
      http3   = true
    }]
    tls = {
      acme = {
        email = "ops@example.com"
        ca    = "letsencrypt-staging" # production rate-limits failed validations
      }
    }
    defaultWafPolicy = kcore_waf_policy.crs.name
    accessLog        = true
  })

  timeouts {
    create = "30m"
  }
}

resource "kcore_ingress_route" "shop" {
  name    = "shop"
  gateway = kcore_ingress_gateway.edge.name
  spec = jsonencode({
    hosts = ["shop.example.com"]
    paths = [{
      prefix = "/"
      backends = [
        { kind = "vm", name = "shop-web-1", port = 8080 },
        { kind = "external", address = "192.168.40.50:8443" },
      ]
      loadBalancing = { policy = "least_conn" }
      healthCheck   = { path = "/healthz", interval = "10s", expectStatus = 200 }
    }]
    redirectHttp = true
  })
}
```

The `spec` is the camelCase document from `docs/user/ingress.md`, sent as the operator wrote it. The controller fills in defaults and does not return the original text, so the provider does not read `spec` back and does not report changes made outside Terraform. Key order and whitespace in `spec` do not cause a diff. Apply plans the gateway first (`kctl ingress plan`) and stops on validation errors.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Gateway name (`metadata.name`).
- `spec` (String) The `spec` of an IngressGateway as JSON, for example `jsonencode({ nodes = ["node-105"], listeners = [...], tls = { acme = {...} } })`. Field names are the camelCase names used in `docs/user/ingress.md`.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `wait_for_ready` (Boolean) Wait until every gateway node has applied the configuration before apply returns.

### Read-Only

- `generation` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `node_status` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_status))
- `phase` (String) pending, applying, ready, degraded, or failed.
- `status_message` (String)
